tool_args.rationale: The long-horizon probe established reversal, but the nominated 5-parameter dual-horizon law failed fresh confirmation badly. A fine trajectory batch is the targeted next measurement for distinguishing a coupled memory ODE from other smooth mechanisms; another model submission without new evidence risks another costly refutation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE 1.126 is far above the 0.045 tolerance, so the current mechanism is refuted.
The observations show a long-horizon sign reversal, but no high-frequency chaotic oscillation or evidence that all stationary smooth mechanisms fail.
Not rejected; this is the selected probe to test the archived coupled memory-ODE alternative after the dual-horizon fit failed.
Nuisance measurements do not resolve the mechanism ambiguity and are explicitly irrelevant.
